name: Acontext
summary: Open-source skill memory layer: distills agent runs into editable Markdown SKILL.md files that agents fetch with tools on the next run; cloud or self-hosted.
description: When a task completes or fails, an LLM distillation pass extracts what worked, what failed and user preferences, and a skill agent writes them into skill files following a schema you define in `SKILL.md`. Recall is by tool use (`get_skill`, `get_skill_file`), not semantic top-k; skills export as ZIP for use with any agent or framework. SDKs: `pip install acontext`, `npm i @acontext/acontext`. Hosted at acontext.io (free credits to start) or self-host with Docker and an OpenAI API key. From the makers of Memobase.
